div.div: مُسَبَّدٌ , like مُعَظَّمٌ, (TA,) or ↓ مُسَبِّدٌ , (accord. to a copy of the M,) as meaning (assumed tropical:) Consummate, (M, * TA,) is applied as an epithet to a calamity, دَاهِيَة, (M, TA,) which a poet terms, for the sake of the measure, أَمُّ فَأْرٍ, because it is termed أُمُّ أَدْرَاصٍ, and دِرْصٌ is applied to a young one of a bitch, and of a she-wolf, and of a she-cat, and of the [species of فَأْر called] جُرَذ, and of the jerboa. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
